summary: DEF-029. Restores the ::uuid casts that the DEF-001/DEF-002 canonical rewrite dropped from the invoice-draft line inserts, and validates the NOT NULL account_id explicitly so the repair does not simply move the failure from 42804 to 23502. Re-issues the two canonical bodies only; no signature, table, policy, trigger or grant is altered.

problem.defect: DEF-029, severity critical. Invoice drafting with lines is broken on LIVE.
problem.introduced_by: THIS PROJECT — migration 20260731210000 (DEF-001/DEF-002), applied 2026-08-01 as executor version 20260801081847. Not inherited. The superseded overloads all carried the cast (see 20251217224432); the canonical rewrite dropped it.
problem.mechanism: Both canonical bodies insert NULLIF(v_line->>'vat_code_id','') and NULLIF(v_line->>'account_id','') — both of type text — into invoice_lines.vat_code_id and invoice_lines.account_id, which are uuid. PostgreSQL raises 42804 'column is of type uuid but expression is of type text' for ANY create or update supplying at least one line. A draft saves only with an empty lines array.
problem.second_defect_found_authoring_this_fix: invoice_lines.account_id is NOT NULL with no default. src/lib/invoice-draft-service.ts sends account_id: line.account_id || '' and the editor allows a line to be saved with no account chosen, so '' reaches the RPC routinely. Restoring the cast ALONE would convert 42804 into a raw 23502 not-null violation for exactly those lines — a different error, the same broken save. The executor's DEF-029 entry describes only the cast; this half is not in it and would have produced a fix that still failed in the common case.
problem.why_both_harnesses_missed_it: Every probe on both verification routes passed an EMPTY lines array — the executor's rolled-back-transaction run and my connector probes alike. The defect is unreachable without at least one line. Recorded in the DEF-001/002 receipt so the next overload or privilege harness includes a populated payload.

design_decisions.decision: Validate account_id, do not default it.
design_decisions.rationale: Which nominal account a line posts to is an accounting decision. Inventing a fallback would put wrong figures in the ledger silently, which the filing-engine architecture in CLAUDE.md forbids — the ledger is the root of every downstream projection. The RPC raises 22023 naming the line instead, in the same shape as the existing quantity/unit_price/vat_rate validations.
design_decisions.guarded_by: A test asserts no default or fallback account is introduced.

design_decisions.rationale: A malformed identifier would otherwise surface as an opaque 22P02 from the cast. It now raises the same 22023 with an actionable message.

design_decisions.decision: Validate before mutating in the update path.
design_decisions.rationale: update_invoice_draft_safe deletes all existing lines then re-inserts. The new checks sit in its PHASE 1 validation loop, ahead of the DELETE, so a bad line is rejected before anything is destroyed. This strengthens the ops-health-line-preservation property the DEF-001/002 receipt verified, rather than relying only on transaction rollback.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION preserves owner and ACL. The DEF-001/002 privilege state (postgres/authenticated/service_role/sandbox_exec; no PUBLIC, no anon) and the DEF-015 revocation therefore carry over untouched. The migration ASSERTS this rather than re-granting, so a silent ACL change fails the apply instead of being papered over.

authoring_method: Both bodies were extracted from the LIVE definitions (create md5 0f9e8acf, update md5 99c9bde5, matching catalog_functions) and edited programmatically against asserted anchors — the script fails if any anchor is absent or matches more than once. Nothing else in either body was retyped, reordered or reformatted. This follows the RPC replacement guard: never re-author a large body by hand.

expected_objects.object: Neither canonical body inserts an uncast NULLIF into a uuid column
expected_objects.verify_via: catalog_functions(name_like 'invoice_draft_safe') with include_source, or pg_proc.prosrc: no occurrence of NULLIF(v_line->>'vat_code_id', ''), or NULLIF(v_line->>'account_id', ''), without ::uuid. The migration asserts this itself before COMMIT; confirm independently after apply.
expected_objects.evidence: LIVE 2026-08-05 via catalog_functions(name_like 'create_invoice_draft_safe', include_source=true). The insert into invoice_lines now reads NULLIF(v_line->>'vat_code_id', '')::uuid, NULLIF(v_line->>'account_id', '')::uuid — both casts present. The account_id validation is also live: the body raises 22023 'Invalid line %: account_id is required' and a second 22023 for a value failing the uuid regex, so the repair did not move the failure from 42804 to 23502. Definition hash e989e584148f06e96e33e75f29d1bea1.

expected_objects.object: A draft carrying at least one well-formed line saves
expected_objects.verify_via: THE PROOF-OF-REPAIR CASE, and the one both harnesses previously skipped. Create a draft with one line carrying a real account_id and a real vat_code_id, then update it with two lines. Before: 42804 on both. After: both succeed and invoice_lines holds the expected rows with the totals recomputed. An EMPTY lines array does NOT exercise this defect and must not be used as evidence.

expected_objects.object: A line with no account_id raises 22023 naming the line, not 23502
expected_objects.verify_via: Call create with a line omitting account_id (or sending ''). Expect 22023 'Invalid line 1: account_id is required'. A 23502 not-null violation here means the validation was skipped and the fix is incomplete.
Call create with account_id 'abc'. Expect 22023 'Invalid line 1: account_id is not a valid identifier'.

expected_objects.object: A rejected update leaves the existing lines intact
expected_objects.verify_via: Take a draft with a line named 'Original Line - DO NOT DELETE'. Update it with two lines, the second missing account_id. The call must raise 22023 and the original line must still be present — count and content unchanged. Validation now precedes the DELETE, so this must hold independently of rollback.

expected_objects.object: Exactly two signatures; no set_rpc_context; anon still has no EXECUTE; authenticated, service_role and sandbox_exec retain it
expected_objects.verify_via: catalog_functions -> exactly 2 invoice-draft rows (14-arg create, 9-arg update). prosrc contains no set_rpc_context. proacl on both: postgres/authenticated/service_role/sandbox_exec, no PUBLIC (=X), no anon. All asserted in-migration; confirm independently, as CREATE OR REPLACE is being relied on to preserve the ACL.
expected_objects.evidence_partial: PARTIALLY verified 2026-08-05. CONFIRMED: catalog_functions(name_like 'invoice_draft_safe') returns exactly two rows — the 14-arg create and the 9-arg update — so no overload was reintroduced; and the create body contains PERFORM set_config('app.rpc','1',true) with no reference to set_rpc_context. NOT CONFIRMED: the proacl half (anon absent; authenticated/service_role/sandbox_exec present). The database connector exposes catalog_grants over information_schema.role_table_grants, which covers TABLE privileges only and cannot read function ACLs — the same limitation recorded in the DEF-001 plan entry. This object stays pending until the executor supplies proacl.

expected_objects.object: The invoice editor refuses to save a line with no account, naming the line
expected_objects.verify_via: APP-SIDE, ships on the next frontend publish, no migration needed. In the invoice editor add a line, leave Account unset, save. Expect an inline 'Line 1: choose an account before saving.' toast and no network round trip.

migrations.rollback_note: No rollback script. Reverting means reinstating a body that raises 42804 on every draft with lines — a fix-forward-only change. The prior bodies remain recoverable from migration 20260731210000 and from the def-hashes recorded in the DEF-001/002 receipt if it ever became necessary.

steps: Apply 20260803120000_def_029_invoice_line_uuid_casts.sql. It is self-verifying: a DO block asserts the end state before COMMIT, so a partial apply aborts.

Reproduce the ORIGINAL failure first if a draft is available — create a draft with one line and confirm 42804 pre-apply. Gate 6 of the verification standard: five defects have reported success while nothing durable happened.
After apply, run draft-with-lines-saves. This is the check that matters; an empty lines array proves nothing.
Then the two error-shape checks and the line-preservation check.
Then confirm signatures, prosrc and proacl are undisturbed.
Refresh docs/audits/unapplied-migrations-baseline.json with the new applied version.
Publish the frontend for the editor-side guard.
Notify Claude to complete this receipt.

The uncast-NULLIF detector was run against the LIVE broken bodies and matches all four occurrences, so it demonstrably catches the defect rather than merely passing on the fix.

open_after_this: DEF-026 approve_bill_safe writes status 'APPROVED', rejected by bills_status_check. Bill approval broken on LIVE.
DEF-027 create_customer_safe inserts four columns absent from public.customers. Customer creation via the safe RPC broken on LIVE.

DEF-028 stamp_portal_provenance() selects portal_access.contact_id, which does not exist — every portal write to a table carrying that trigger fails 42703. Critical, and it blocks the portal-capability check on the DEF-001/002 receipt.

DEF-030 can_create_invoices requires role >= staff while organization_users_role_check permits only owner/admin/staff, so the capability branch can never refuse a member. Needs an owner ruling: widen the role vocabulary, or delete the dead branch.
verification_note_2026_08_05: Reviewed independently of the executor. One of seven expected objects passes and one is partially confirmed. The remaining five are NOT verifiable by the reviewing party: draft-with-lines-saves and update-destroys-nothing-on-a-bad-line require writing real invoice drafts to the production database, which was not authorised; editor-blocks-the-save-client-side requires a frontend publish and a manual UI interaction; and the proacl half of def-001-002-015-undisturbed needs a catalog the connector cannot reach. Per convention section 3 this receipt therefore REMAINS in pending/ and must not be marked applied-verified. The correction that matters is live_apply: the migration IS on LIVE and the invoice-draft regression DEF-029 is closed at the code level.
